items.text:
Depending on which path is taken here, this would be very unfortunate. In the more extreme bans, we would be asymmetrically disadvantaging ourselves. 

America would reduce the options for AI models in our market, whereas the rest of the world would keep gaining access to both closed and open models. 

We’d have fewer options for driving down the cost of AI, tuning models to industry-specific use-cases, improving the security of systems, and keeping competitive dynamics going to keep pushing the frontier of research. All bad outcomes.

This should at least be a wake up call for American OSS investment.

items.text:
这两天，我把视频制作的工作流彻底重构了一下。

之前使用 Hermes，后来又用 Codex 拼拼凑凑，勉强能跑，但中间的冗余环节太多了，导致整个流程出现了很多内耗和自我博弈打架的情况。修修补补下来发现还是不行，最后只能让它在学习原有工作流的基础上，彻底进行重构。

最近这两天，我一直在花大量的时间，让它帮我梳理整个工作流的系统架构。光是系统架构层面，我就花了两天时间，让它反反复复地进行修改和调整，同时把中间各种环节给调顺。这个逻辑架构一旦调顺了之后，后面就可以设置个目标，让它自己去搭建了。

我觉得，工作流前期的流程架构，一定是我们需要重度参与的环节。至于架构打好之后，后面的实现端，其实 Codex 实现起来比我要好得多得多。
items.summary: 作者用 Hermes/Codex 拼流程冗余内耗后彻底重构。花两天反复梳理系统架构、理顺环节；架构顺了再设目标让它自建。结论：前期流程架构要人重度参与，实现端 Codex 往往强于自己。
items.recommend_reason: 人机分工边界说得清楚：架构归人、实现归 agent。
items.title: 视频工作流重构：架构必须人重度参与，实现交给 Codex

items.text:
你在中转站选的模型可能被偷偷调包：输入一个随机数，就能验明正身

像 OpenRouter 这样的聚合商，一个入口接入几百个模型，确实省事。但你点的只是一个名字，请求最后落到哪台机器、上面跑的是什么，你完全看不见，也没有任何凭证。

布拉格经济大学的 Tomáš Bruckner 想出了一个巧办法：让 AI 说个随机数，光看它怎么答，就能认出它是谁。

这招利用的是 AI 一个出了名的毛病：它说不出真正的随机数。你让它 1 到 100 随便挑，它翻来覆去就挑那一两个，而且每家模型的「口头禅数字」还不一样：GPT-4o 最偏爱 42（37 和 57 也常说），Claude Sonnet 5 几乎只说 47，Qwen3-Max 更绝，30 次采样每一次都答 42。

以前大家都把这当缺陷、研究怎么修，这篇论文反过来，把它当成了指纹。

详细内容：https://t.co/H32YwvEyeX
items.summary: 聚合商入口只显示名字，实际跑什么看不见。布拉格经济大学提出：让 AI 报 1–100 随机数，利用「说不出真随机」的口头禅数字当指纹——如 GPT-4o 爱 42，Claude Sonnet 爱 47，Qwen3-Max 30 次全是 42。缺陷变识别凭证。
items.recommend_reason: 可操作的验模型手段，用中转站的人该会。
items.title: 中转站模型可能被调包：让 AI 报随机数当指纹

items.text:
YOUR PHONE CAN NOW RUN A 27B AI MODEL.

Most people think powerful AI needs the cloud.

They just got proven wrong.

Here's what changed:

→ PrismML compressed a 27B model from ~54GB down to 3.9GB

→ It runs directly on a phone with no internet required

→ Built from Qwen 3.6 27B using a new 1-bit compression technique

What you actually get:

✓ 262K token context window

✓ Multimodal (images + text)

✓ On-device reasoning

✓ Structured tool calling

✓ Around 11 tokens/sec on an iPhone 17 Pro Max

The tradeoff:

✔ Reasoning, math, and coding stay surprisingly strong

✔ Vision, instruction following, and factual recall take the biggest hit

✔ Independent benchmark verification is still pending

The biggest breakthrough isn't a smarter model.

It's fitting serious AI in your pocket without sending your data anywhere.
items.summary: PrismML 将约 54GB 的 27B 模型压到 3.9GB，可在手机无网上跑（基于 Qwen 3.6 27B 的 1-bit 压缩）。约 262K 上下文、多模态、端侧推理与工具调用；iPhone 17 Pro Max 约 11 tok/s。推理/数学/代码仍强，视觉与事实召回受损，独立基准待验。
items.recommend_reason: 端侧大模型的尺寸突破，隐私与离线场景打开。

items.text:
China just dropped the biggest open AI model ever... and I already replaced part of my Agent OS with it.

Most people are still comparing chatbots. They're missing what happens when you plug this into real AI workflows.

What Kimi K3 actually brings:

→ 2.8 trillion parameters, making it the largest open-weight model released.

→ Up to a 1M token context window, up from 256K.

→ Beats Claude Opus 4.8 on multiple benchmarks.

Where it surprised me:

✓ #1 on the Design Arena leaderboard.

✓ Huge leap in 3D game generation compared to the previous Kimi release.

✓ Agent workflows ran smoothly inside Hermes with memory and existing automations.

Reality check:

✔ Website generation still looks generic without good prompts.

✔ Add proper design instructions and the quality jumps immediately.

The biggest advantage isn't the benchmark.

It's being able to swap frontier models into your own Agent OS the day they launch instead of waiting for one AI company to catch up.
items.summary: 作者称 K3 为最大开源权重模型之一（2.8T、上下文至 1M），多基准超过 Claude Opus 4.8；Design Arena 第一、3D 游戏生成跃升，Hermes 里 agent 工作流顺。网站生成仍需好设计指令。最大优势是当日即可换进自有 Agent OS，不必等单一厂商。
items.recommend_reason: 开源旗舰进真实工作流的即时替换叙事。

items.text:
In a world where there are strong open source alternatives that are only just behind the frontier models, you make yourself less secure and competitive by gatekeeping access to frontier model capabilities.

If you play this out, even if America could fully ban access to open source models, other ecosystems wouldn't have that ban and they'd have a leg up on access to those models. They could use them against us -or just use them to better defend themselves- and our own companies wouldn't be able to keep up.

The calculus of what you do about AI regulation simply must change to account for the fact that open weights models are far stronger than many expected.
items.summary: Box CEO：在开源只落后前沿一点点时，锁死前沿能力反而更不安全、更没竞争力。即便美国全面禁开源，其他生态仍可拿到并用来进攻或自保，美国公司跟不上。AI 监管算账必须承认开源权重模型远比预期更强。
items.recommend_reason: 把开源与监管博弈讲成竞争动力学，不是口号。

items.text:
AI 音乐平台 Suno 被黑客攻破，泄露的源码揭开了整个训练数据的来源清单

11.3 万小时 YouTube Music 内容、6.2 万小时 Pond5 音乐、1.2 万小时 Deezer、还有计划爬取 100 万小时播客

这些数字直接写在代码注释里，连藏都没藏

更严重的是 6000 万用户的邮箱、手机号和 Stripe 支付信息也一起泄露了

Suno 的回应是"去年 11 月已经发现并控制了这次事件"，但他们没有通知任何用户

这件事的意义远超 Suno 本身：整个 AI 音乐行业的训练数据合法性问题被摆到了台面上

Spotify 刚删了 7500 万首 AI 歌曲，现在 Suno 的源码证实了这些模型到底是怎么训练出来的

当训练数据的来源从"我们不便透露"变成了"黑客帮你透露"，这个行业的信任危机才刚开始

你还敢把自己的音乐上传到 AI 平台吗？
